verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents continuous automatic reconciliation, accrual/cash accounting choice, and accountant collaboration with comments/tagging on transactions, which cover pieces of a close workflow, but there is no evidence of a structured month-end close checklist, accrual entry tracking, or formal review/sign-off workflow as a discrete feature. missing for 10: dedicated close checklist UI, accrual journal entry workflow, formal sign-off/approval tracking for close tasks.
